correctness.rationale: The real unit ball of N(s,t)=max(|s|,|t|,(|s|+|t|)/sqrt2) has eight vertices ±(1,√2−1), ±(√2−1,1) with all sign rotations. The adjacent antipodal quadruple has zero centroid and two distances 2(√2−1), four distances2, yielding 40−16√2. For each of 8^4 ordered choices of sphere edges, the centroid equalities cut out a compact affine parameter polytope of rank1 or2; the objective ΣN(x_i−x_j)^2 is convex on each. Thus maxima lie at affine-polytope vertices, captured by fixing 3 (rank1) or 2 (rank2) parameters to endpoints and solving the rest. Exact Q(√2) source verifier fully inspected, including its exact comparison arithmetic and degenerate rank-one case, enumerates 4032 rank2 and64 rank1 cells and exactly 11136+576=11712 candidate occurrences. A separately coded independent floating-point full vertex-cell enumeration yielded the SAME counts and maximum 17.37258300203048=40−16√2. Independently evaluated 64 octagon-vertex pairs for C_NJprime=4−2√2. Since the exact source verifier uses rational-pair arithmetic, the finite certificate is exhaustive after convexity, not sampling.
